data.value: Technical facts as a basis (not legal text)

data.name: Facts.Intro
data.value: This list describes what the website does technically. It is a working basis for the privacy policy and does not replace it.

data.name: Facts.NoTracking
data.value: No trackers, no analytics, no ads and no third-party embeds. Fonts and all files are served from this server.

data.name: Facts.LangCookie
data.value: Cookie "pubpot_lang": stores the chosen language. It is only set when someone clicks the language switcher and lasts one year.

data.name: Facts.Theme
data.value: Browser storage "pubpot-theme" (localStorage): stores the choice between light and dark theme. The value never leaves the browser.

data.name: Facts.Forms
data.value: Sign-up forms: the details are stored in order to get in touch, together with the consent (text version and time). A sign-up only counts once confirmed by email (double opt-in). Unconfirmed sign-ups are deleted automatically after 30 days. Deletion on request is possible at any time.

data.name: Facts.Mail
data.value: Emails are sent via an SMTP provider in the EU (TODO: choose provider).

data.name: Facts.Hosting
data.value: Hosted on a dedicated server at Hetzner (TODO: choose location).

data.name: Facts.Logs
data.value: The application doesn't write personal data to its logs (TODO: decide on web server access logs).

data.name: Facts.Antiforgery
data.value: Security cookie ".AspNetCore.Antiforgery.…": set on pages with a form to protect against forged form submissions (CSRF). It contains no personal details and is deleted when the browser is closed.

data.name: Facts.RateLimit
data.value: Spam protection: when a form is sent, the IP address is used briefly in memory to limit too many requests from the same address (at most 10 minutes). It is neither stored in the database nor logged.

data.name: Facts.Retention
data.value: Retention: unconfirmed sign-ups are deleted 30 days after the last submission, sent confirmation emails 7 days after sending, undeliverable ones after 30 days. Confirmed sign-ups: if nothing has happened for 12 months (no response from you, no processing by us), you'll receive an email with the link "I'd like to stay". Without a click, we delete the sign-up 30 days after that email. TODO: add retention in backups (phase 7), have it reviewed by a lawyer.
